question: On six never-used CNS seeds, do the push-response LOOP_AMPLIFIES and the offset-yoke OFFSETS_DO_NOT_REPRODUCE replicate, and how large is the seed-to-seed spread of R, E and R_Y?
not_an_admission_test: No coordinate status changes from any outcome; earlier reports, labels and texts are not edited.

sources.reused_code: coxa_push_response (Trial behaviour, create_session, candidate_defs, force_ok, deviation_integral, prefix_equal) and coxa_offset_yoke (Trial apply/capture, selected_action, schedule, yoke_audit, reproduces, label) by import; neither edited

context: push-response context unchanged: Step C A_ON, 20 v3 channels, Thorax pulse +-1.024 on outgoing transitions 5000-5199 zero torque via external_force_by_transition, 20000 physics / 4000 neural transitions, brain.rng = default_rng(seed) at attach

sets.C: four CONDITIONAL channels H1 (COXA_CONDITIONAL_H1), definitions sha256 dd337259c21aa9b3368f38cf3b9e28c724f6a14b901bedcc610afa3ae7daa12b
sets.Y: N configuration with actions joint_LFCoxa 0, joint_LMCoxa 7, joint_LHCoxa 14, joint_RMCoxa 28 yoked to this run's C0_s (sample n+1)

integrity.I2_reproduction: REPRO_N0_1 equals push-response N0_1 (hash-verified) over the whole run: qpos and commands every sample; fired, uniforms, hair deliveries every tick
integrity.I3_common_rng: within each seed, all 9 arms have identical per-tick uniforms and external schedule
integrity.I4_exact_force: coxa_push_response.force_ok for every arm with its push
integrity.I5_channels_bounds: push-response I5 rules for N and C arms
integrity.I6_yoke: Y source_sha256 equals this run's C0_s file hash; Y0_s equals C0_s over the whole run; yoke_audit passes; v3 inventory equals N0_s; no hypothesis channel or label
integrity.I7_prefixes_seeds: pushed arms equal own _0 arm through physics index 5000 (qpos, commands) and ticks <= 500 ms; C arms equal N until their first coxa command; tick-1 uniforms of seeds 7-12 distinct from each other and from seeds 1-3; every arm records its seed

pulse_precondition: metrics.response(N{F,B}_s, N0_s).resolved_perturbation for every new seed and direction; else INCONCLUSIVE_PULSE with no labels

measures.D: coxa_push_response.deviation_integral vs own _0 control, states 5201..20000, model mm * s
measures.pooled_reported: per direction over seeds 1-3 (from the two hash-verified committed reports) plus 7-12: median, min, max, mean and sample SD of log R, log E, log R_Y; SD of D(N); labelled as pooled, never relabelling earlier tests
reported: C-arm loop modulation: mean |c(Cp)-c(C0)| per coxa index over the cleared window, differing transitions

Q1.AMPLIFICATION_DIRECTIONAL: not REPLICATES and R > 1 in all 6 (exact one-sided sign test p = 1/64)

labels.Q2a: coxa_offset_yoke.label unchanged on the 6 new seeds (OFFSETS_REPRODUCE / OFFSETS_PARTLY_REPRODUCE / OFFSETS_DO_NOT_REPRODUCE); the earlier label replicates if OFFSETS_DO_NOT_REPRODUCE

consequence_declared_in_advance: Q1 REPLICATES or DIRECTIONAL: the conditional coxa channels reliably make the assisted body easier to displace fore-aft for this pulse (a robust body-level property, not a balance contribution). NOT_REPLICATED: the earlier label was not robust beyond seeds 1-3 and stays recorded for them. Q2a DO_NOT with Q2b INCREASE_D: the amplification consistently depends on free post-push coxa commands. Q2b NO_CONSISTENT_SIGN: the yoke contrast is dominated by seed-level divergence; the earlier mechanism finding stays a three-seed result. No channel, weight, threshold, gain, magnitude or seed changes; no status changes; coverage stays 20/42 admitted, +4 conditional.
interpretation_limits: Seeds vary only stochastic sensory timing.
With 6 seeds only unanimity reaches one-sided p < 0.05 in the sign rule; a moderate effect cannot be distinguished from none.
One engineering pulse; only the four fore-aft conditional channels.
The reproduction arm checks the environment, not biological validity.
